hints.title: HEAVY THINGS
hints.text: A boulder blocks the tunnel. Walk into it to push it along - sideways only, and only one at a time. Where the floor ends, it falls.
hints.task: Push it east into the pit, walk over it and climb out.

hints.title: LOOSE ROCK
hints.text: A boulder falls as soon as nothing holds it, and on rock it rolls into a hole that opens right beside it. A falling boulder kills - and the lithium lies in a pit with no way out.
hints.task: Dig the earth lid only once the boulder cannot follow you down: push it clear of the hole first.

hints.title: TOXIC BARREL
hints.text: A barrel is pushed and falls like a boulder - but one that lands after a fall explodes, and the blast breaks the earth and ice around it. Never be underneath one.
hints.task: The ice ahead cannot be dug. Push the barrel into the hole at its foot.

hints.title: DYNAMITE
hints.text: The boulder ahead has rock behind it and cannot be pushed. Key 1 lays a stick where you stand; its fuse burns down with every step and every second, five in all. The blast clears boulders, ice and earth - never rock.
hints.task: Take the sticks, lay one right beside the boulder and get two tiles away.

hints.title: KEY AND DOOR
hints.text: The door ahead opens only with a key, and each key opens one door. This key is frozen in below the tunnel.
hints.task: Blast the ice from above, fetch the key and open the door.

hints.title: ON YOUR OWN
hints.text: The last element lies under the ice at the bottom of this shaft. Everything you need you have met in this lesson.
hints.task: Open the shaft - without being in it.
